name: Bibigo Steamed Chicken & Vegetable Dumplings (Tray with Dipping Sauce)
whyItWorks: Thin, delicate steamed wrappers filled with minced white chicken breast, cabbage, and soy sauce. The filling is pre-ground fine and steamed tender, requiring virtually zero digestive effort.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Tear corner of steam bag and microwave for 1 minute 45 seconds. Dip in low-sodium tamari or coconut aminos.
watchOuts: Filling contains mild alliums; well-tolerated in remission and mild symptoms.
